messages:
aashna: dropped an alternative timeline mock — 'traffic density ribbon' instead of bars. shows percent density per version with subtle gradients. https://figma.com/file/zzzz
sam: ribbon reads cleaner on small screens. does it encode percent or raw?
aashna: percent by default, with a small toggle to raw. hover shows exact numbers and cohort tag.
lin: agree percent helps compare canaries. one thought: use patterned fills for status (canary, baseline, experiment) for colorblind folks.
maria: +1 on pattern fills. also need screen reader labels for each ribbon segment — don't rely on color/title alone. aria-live summary when focused.
aashna: planned aria summary like: "11:15 — v3.1: 18% traffic (mobile) — canary B". will implement aria-live and focus styles.
sam: rollback control in the mock is inline (small caret) 1 think it's easy to misclick. propose explicit 'Rollback' action that opens a focused panel with confirm flow.
lin: +1. panel should show affected variants, traffic shifts, and an option to preview the post-rollback timeline. keyboard accessible and focus trapped.
aashna: good. question: show estimated impact (latency, cost)? could be useful but also noisy. maybe collapsible "Impact" section.
maria: make it collapsed by default. for SR when opening the panel, announce a concise preview. include permission/2FA note if prod workspace.
deploy-bot: reminder: prod rollbacks require 2FA and admin role. add copy under confirm button: 'Requires 2FA and workspace admin privileges.'
sam: microcopy nit: change confirm label from "Confirm rollback" -> "Confirm and rollback traffic" to be explicit.
lin: also add a small transient undo banner after action: "Rollback executed. Undo available for 5 minutes." link to revert. announces via aria-live.
aashna: will iterate mocks: ribbon + patterned fills, %/raw toggle, hover raw numbers, aria-live cell summaries, rollback panel w/ collapsed impact section, 2FA copy, updated confirm copy, undo banner. posting updated figma in ~90m.
maria: thanks. tiny accessibility checklist for the handoff would be great (keyboard nav, aria labels, contrast checks).
aashna: will add checklist in the file comments. leaving thread open for last-minute nits.
thread_summary: Design discussion about an alternative 'traffic density ribbon' for rollout timeline, percent vs raw toggle, patterned fills for accessibility, aria-live summaries, and a safer rollback panel with collapsed impact, 2FA copy, and undo banner.
